## Selected Work

- [AWS Podcast Platform](https://github.com/deeppatel0311/aws-podcast):
  Converts AWS RSS feeds into podcast audio automatically — AI-generated
  scripts via Amazon Bedrock, voiced with Amazon Polly, fully serverless
  (Lambda, DynamoDB, S3). Live: https://deeppatel0311.github.io/aws-podcast/
- [Word Wizard](https://github.com/deeppatel0311/word-wizard): Fast text
  processing tool built with React — case conversion, text manipulation,
  encoding utilities. Live: https://deeppatel0311.github.io/word-wizard
- [Android User Authentication](https://github.com/deeppatel0311/android-authenticate-user):
  Secure native Android authentication with biometric login, JWT token
  management, and encrypted local storage.
